title: Focus on input after refining
body:
Can we focus back on the input after refining. This is the current behavior for magento => https://magento.algolia.com/catalogsearch/result/?q=__empty__#q=&page=0&refinements=%5B%5D&numerics_refinements=%7B%7D&index_name=%22magento_default_products%22

And I think this something good

comments.body: We were thinking of providing events (`on('refine')`), that could let you do that. I would not do that as a default behavior in the library, though. Focusing will scroll the page and this is something really dependent on the UI you're building (can be desirable or not).
I understand. on('refine') works for me

> And I think this something good

Not sure about that; neither Google nor Amazon do it for instance.
Yes if you do that you are saying to the user "you were using your mouse? Lets switch  to keyboard! Yolo"

Amazon does not do it but they do not have instant search. Google is a bit different since it's not an e-commerce

I think it's good for e-commerce website and it goes with what we pitch which is going back and forth between search and navigation.
Probably this is not something to put by default. But I think we should be able to do it easily

> it goes with what we pitch which is going back and forth between search and navigation.

Agree, but that doesn't mean we need to force the user to do it; focusing the search bar seems like a very strong suggestion :)

> But I think we should be able to do it easily

Sure.
Yep make sense. Maybe an option would indeed be better in magento
Cool, let's close this issue then, we'll check how to eventually plug the `on("refine"....`
